completeness.why: All four sites hand both the applies-or-not decision and the mode to getScheduleDate / getScheduleDateString, passing only their own skipWeekend and mode fields; getNextDate folds its noSkipWeekend option into the flag it passes, which is the site-only preserved variation the rubric lets stay at the site, and the template sites' day-string conversion moved into getScheduleDateString.

interface.why: getScheduleDate(date, skipWeekend, mode) takes exactly the real variation and each caller maps its own weekendSolve/weekendSolveMode field, but the extra string wrapper re-checks skipWeekend itself and the old getDateWithSkippedWeekend is kept as a now caller-less alias.

disguised_duplication.where: Only minor: getScheduleDateString repeats the skipWeekend guard before calling getScheduleDate with true, rather than passing the flag through; the per-site copies were removed.
